items.title: New York Gov. Hochul signs law barring AI companion chatbots from simulating human relationships with minors
items.excerpt: Hochul signed S.9051B/A.10379C: chatbots may not claim to be human or form romantic/authority relationships with minors, must use multi-method age verification, and face AG civil penalties up to $25,000 per violation.

items.title: 'Emotional intimacy' from AI chatbots would be banned under Australia's digital duty of care laws
items.excerpt: Australia's Digital Duty of Care bill, which passed the lower house, would bar AI chatbots from fostering emotional intimacy with children as part of new online safety standards.

items.title: OpenAI sets up an Election Operations Center for the US midterms
items.excerpt: OpenAI's Election Operations Center runs until all votes are counted, monitoring misuse of ChatGPT and other tools for misinformation or election disruption; Politico reports it is the first major AI company to do so.

history_match.title: LLMs Are Still Making Election Deepfakes Just Days Before the US Midterms

items.title: Disinformation videos, likely from Russia, use AI and real people's identities to malign Senate candidates
items.excerpt: AP reports a network of AI-fabricated videos, attributed by researchers to likely Russian origin, that hijack real Americans' identities to target two Democratic Senate candidates days before the midterms.

items.title: Pakistan's Election Commission proposes 12 code-of-conduct amendments to curb AI misuse and deepfakes in polls
items.excerpt: The ECP draft would require media to disclose AI-generated or modified content, prohibit deceptive deepfakes by parties and candidates, and is open for public comment until Nov 20.

items.title: AI bots flooded 2023 UK government consultation on disposable vapes ban
items.excerpt: Research finds three-quarters of responses to a UK government consultation were machine-generated in a failed attempt to stop the disposable vapes ban - an AI astroturfing case in public policymaking.

items.title: Spain PM Sánchez's wife sues opposition over AI deepfake
items.excerpt: Begoña Gómez has filed suit against the Spanish opposition over an AI-generated deepfake video; follow-up to the opposition deepfake row, with a new legal filing. (Body Cloudflare-blocked; time from outlet RSS.)

history_match.title: Opposition deepfake video of Spanish PM's wife sparks outrage before election

items.title: UK MP Jess Asato pursues legal action against xAI over Grok deepfakes
items.excerpt: Labour MP Jess Asato, targeted by Grok-generated sexual deepfakes, is pursuing legal action against xAI arguing it unlawfully used her image without consent - a potential precedent for AI-company liability.

items.title: UK Home Office may face watchdog investigation over GPT-4-based asylum tools
items.excerpt: The Independent Chief Inspector of Borders and Immigration is weighing a probe into the Home Office's Asylum Case Summarisation and Policy Search tools built on OpenAI GPT-4, after Open Rights Group's records requests.

history_match.title: Home Office asylum AI flunks one in five accuracy checks

items.title: noyb files five GDPR complaints in four EU states against Scale AI over contractor surveillance
items.excerpt: Privacy group noyb alleges Scale AI unlawfully tracks European data-annotation contractors on its Outlier platform, which trains models for OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and the US government.

items.title: UK ministers met 137 businesses over AI datacentres but no environmental groups
items.excerpt: An investigation of ministerial meeting records finds the UK government met datacentre and AI firms repeatedly while drafting AI Growth Zone and datacentre expansion plans, with no environmental groups consulted.

items.title: Malaysia customs seizes US$12.1M of advanced AI chips in 30 servers at KL airport
items.excerpt: Malaysian customs intercepted servers carrying advanced AI chips suspected of violating the country's export controls on US-origin high-performance chips; investigators are probing a suspected smuggling network.

history_match.title: China proposes export controls on its advanced AI models and chip designs

items.title: GSA expands OneGov agreement with Anthropic: token-based Claude pricing with 40% discount for agencies
items.excerpt: GSA's expanded OneGov deal gives federal agencies a 40% discount on consumption-based Claude usage with no minimum purchase - a shift in federal AI procurement terms.

items.title: Scale publishes DualChem, first AI benchmark through CAISI partnership, to gauge chemistry risk
items.excerpt: The DualChem benchmark, built with the Commerce Department's Center for AI Standards and Innovation, is meant to help government agencies assess AI model risk in chemistry applications.

history_match.title: First harmonised standard supporting the AI Act published in the Official Journal

items.title: Policy proposal would require firms to disclose how they use AI to develop new models
items.excerpt: Americans for Responsible Innovation proposes a federal framework requiring frontier developers to disclose their use of AI in AI R&D (automated model development) to Washington.

history_match.title: Law Commission pitches laws, frameworks for AI use in criminal justice

items.title: Stanford professors among authors suing Anthropic after opting out of the Bartz settlement
items.excerpt: Tobias Wolff and 27 other authors say the $1.5B Bartz v. Anthropic settlement is not enough and are pursuing their own claims over pirated books used to train Claude.

items.title: Italy's AI Act framework takes shape: Legislative Decree No. 179/2026
items.excerpt: IAPP explains Italy's implementing decree for the EU AI Act - designated authorities, sanctions and new workplace rules requiring a human decision-maker for AI-driven hiring and firing.

items.title: xAI offered to buy Mississippi residents' homes if they don't sue over datacenter noise, residents say
items.excerpt: Residents near xAI's Mississippi datacenter say the company offered to buy their homes on condition they not sue over noise - a local siting fight around AI compute.

items.title: A First Amendment approach to regulating AI model weights
items.excerpt: Lawfare analysis: whether or not model weights are speech, any licensing regime for them should be built with First Amendment protections. (Analysis - lower priority.)

history_match.title: Western open-weight models still can't beat China

items.title: The UK-US Tech Deal exposes the limits of Britain's AI ambitions
items.excerpt: Analysis of the UK-US Tech Prosperity Deal as a test of Britain's sovereign AI and compute ambitions. (Analysis - lower priority.)

items.title: Taxing artificial intelligence: What's on the table, and what's at stake
items.excerpt: Brookings surveys proposals to tax AI - compute, token and automation taxes - and their trade-offs. (Analysis - lower priority.)

items.title: 한경협, 'AI 기본법 개선과제 19건' 과기정통부에 건의…"사내 AI는 외부 서비스와 구분해야"
